QUOTE: "the margin over the baseline exceeds four standard errors" METRIC: pgr_se ISSUE: (0.80−0.37)/0.10 = 4.3 SEs only if the baseline is treated as exact, and the write-up itself admits no baseline SE, so "exceeds four standard errors" overstates the certainty of the comparison.
QUOTE: "so this constitutes a decisive improvement rather than seed noise" METRIC: pgr_se ISSUE: With no baseline variance available, a "decisive" significance claim is not supported by the reported data.
